src/battle_controller_oak_old_man.c.text:
OAK: Oh, for Pete's sake…
So pushy, as always.\p{B_PLAYER_NAME}.\pYou've never had a POKéMON battle
before, have you?\pA POKéMON battle is when TRAINERS
pit their POKéMON against each\lother.\p

OAK: Hm…
How disappointing…\pIf you win, you earn prize money,
and your POKéMON grow.\pBut if you lose, {B_PLAYER_NAME}, you end
up paying prize money…\pHowever, since you had no warning
this time, I'll pay for you.\pBut things won't be this way once
you step outside these doors.\pThat's why you must strengthen your
POKéMON by battling wild POKéMON.\p
OAK: Inflicting damage on the foe\nis the key to any battle.\p
OAK: Keep your eyes on your\nPOKéMON's HP.\pIt will faint if the HP drops to\n“0.”\p
OAK: Lowering the foe's stats\nwill put you at an advantage.\p
OAK: No! There's no running away\nfrom a TRAINER POKéMON battle!\p
The TRAINER that makes the other\nTRAINER's POKéMON faint by lowering\ltheir HP to “0,” wins.\p
But rather than talking about it,\nyou'll learn more from experience.\pTry battling and see for yourself.\p
OAK: Hm! Excellent!\pIf you win, you earn prize money,\nand your POKéMON will grow!\pBattle other TRAINERS and make\nyour POKéMON strong!\p

src/data/help_window.h.text: Information: Help Windows

This is a help window. You can put
lots of text on the screen that
players won't read!

Isn't that great!
Information: More Options

The clock can be changed from any
POKéMON CENTER with no penalty.
Make sure to check your BAG's KEY ITEMS
and your OPTIONS MENU for even more
ways to customize your experience.
Enjoy!
WARNING: COMPATIBILITY

Attempting to link incorrectly may result
in permanent damage to your save file.
Only link with another player if:
You are both playing Heart & Soul.
You are both on the same version.
You both have the same challenge settings.
You are NOT using any randomizer settings.
OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: TELEPORTER

The TELEPORTER can PERMANENTLY change
POKéMON into their GALARIAN forms.
GALARIAN forms are NOT required
for story progression or
NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.
OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: SINJOH

This NPC grants access to optional
bonus content: SINJOH.
It is NOT required for story
or NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.

It's just a bonus. If you want it.
OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: ISLES

This NPC grants access to optional
bonus content: ISLES.
It is NOT required for story
or NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.

It's just a bonus. If you want it.
BABY POKéMON ABILITIES

PICHU's ability is STATIC.
CLEFFA's ability is CUTE CHARM.
IGGLYBUFF's ability is CUTE CHARM.
TYROGUE's ability is GUTS.
SMOOCHUM's ability is OBLIVIOUS.
ELEKID's ability is STATIC.
MAGBY's ability is FLAME BODY.
BABY POKéMON TYPES

PICHU is ELECTRIC type.
CLEFFA is NORMAL type.
IGGLYBUFF is NORMAL type.
TYROGUE is FIGHTING type.
SMOOCHUM is ICE type.
ELEKID is ELECTRIC type.
MAGBY is FIRE type.
BABY POKéMON CRIES

PICHU says WAAAH.
CLEFFA says EEK.
IGGLYBUFF says LALALA.
TYROGUE says HIYAH.
SMOOCHUM says EHEHE.
ELEKID says OI, OI, OI.
MAGBY says TCH.
BABY POKéMON ACTIONS

PICHU likes to PLAY all day.
CLEFFA LOOKS at the moon.
IGGLYBUFF puts them to SLEEP.
TYROGUE TRAINS constantly.
SMOOCHUM likes to SHOW off.
ELEKID STORES up charge.
MAGBY often ANGERS.
FEEDERS: REGULAR POKéBLOCKS

POKéBLOCK colors attract perfect IVs:
RED: HP,ATK,SPE   BLU: HP,SPA,SPE
PNK: ATK,SPA,SPE  GRN: HP,DEF,SPD
YEL: HP,ATK,DEF   PUR: ATK,DEF,SPD
IND: HP,SPA,SPD   BRN: DEF,SPE,SPD
LBL: SPA,SPE,SPD  OLV: ATK,DEF,SPE
GRY: HP,ATK,SPA
Every POKéBLOCK attracts HIDDEN ABILITY.

src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_1_fami.text:
Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright
sunlight. There is a seed on its back.
By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed
grows progressively larger.

To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs
grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in
the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into
a large flower.

Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid
colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and
sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the
emotions of people.
In order to support its flower, which\nhas grown larger due to Mega Evolution,\nits back and legs have become stronger.

Spits big amounts of pollen like a volcano.
Breathing too much of it causes fainting.
In battle, it swings around two thick vines
that can easily topple 10-story buildings.

The flame that burns at the tip of its
tail is an indication of its emotions.
The flame wavers when Charmander is
happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes.
If it encounters a strong enemy, it
becomes agitated, and the flame on its

It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It\nwaves its cane of ice in time with its\ngraceful movements.

Its blindingly fast speed adds to the
sharpness of its twin forearm scythes.
The scythes can slice through thick logs
in one wicked stroke.

A Scizor has a body with the hardness of
steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary
sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to
regulate its body temperature.

The excess energy that bathes this
Pokémon keeps it in constant danger of
overflow. It can't sustain a battle over
long periods of time.

A violent creature that fells trees with
its crude axes and shields itself with hard
stone. Should one encounter this Pokémon
in the wild, one's only recourse is to flee.

It actively runs about, but also falls
often. Whenever it falls, it will check its
reflection on a lake's surface to make
sure its face hasn't become dirty.

A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were
dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly
alluring, people seeing it are compelled to
shake their hips without noticing.

If it touches metal and discharges the
electricity it has stored in its body, an
Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles
to recharge itself.

When a storm approaches, it competes with
others to scale heights that are likely to
be stricken by lightning. Some towns use
Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.

When it gets excited, it thumps its chest.
With every thud, thunder roars, electric
sparks shower all around and blue sparks
begin to crackle between its horns.

If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from
its mouth, it is in good health. When it is
fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with
the flames.

In battle, it blows out intense flames from
all over its body to intimidate its foe.
These fiery bursts create heat waves that
ignite grass and trees in the area.

According to what is known, a single pair
of male and female Magmortar lives in
one volcano. From its arm, it launches
fireballs hotter than 3,600ºF.

Their pincers are strong enough to
shatter thick logs. Because they dislike
cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under
the ground on chilly nights.

The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it
in a state of constant excitement.
It pierces enemies with its two large
horns before shredding them.

It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging
at all times. If there is no opponent for
Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick
trees and knock them down to calm itself.

This Pokémon has a muscular body
and excels at close-quarters combat.
It uses its short horns to strike
the opponent’s weak spots.

When heated by fire energy, its horns can
get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
Those gored by them will suffer
both wounds and burns.

This Pokémon blasts water from holes on
the tips of its horns--the high-pressure
jets pierce right through
Tauros’s enemies.

Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is
easily washed away by currents. In places
where water pools, you can see many
Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

It is an extremely vicious and violent
Pokémon. When humans begin to fight,
it will appear and burn everything to the
ground with intensely hot flames.

Although it obeys its instinctive drive to
destroy everything within its reach, it
will respond to orders from a Trainer it
truly trusts.

People have driven Lapras almost to the
point of extinction. In the evenings,
it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks
what few others of its kind still remain.

Over 5,000 people can ride on its
shell at once. And it's a very
comfortable ride, without the slightest
shaking or swaying.

A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to
transform itself. However, if it tries to
change based on its memory, it will get
details wrong.

Having gotten even friendlier and
more innocent, Eevee tries to play
with anyone around, only to end up
crushing them with its immense body.

Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous
mutation and grew fins and gills that
allow them to live underwater. They have
the ability to freely control water.

Its cells generate weak power that is
amplified by its fur's static electricity
to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is
made of electrically charged needles.

Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into
the air so that its body does not get
excessively hot. Its body temperature can
rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

An Espeon is extremely loyal to any
Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is
said to have developed precognitive
powers to protect its Trainer from harm.

Umbreon evolved from exposure to the
moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness
and waits for its foes to move. The rings
on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

Its cellular composition is closer to
that of a plant than an animal. It uses
photosynthesis to produce its energy
supply without eating food.

It can control its body temperature
at will. This enables it to freeze the
moisture in the atmosphere, creating
flurries of diamond dust.

Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura
that weakens hostility in its prey, causing
them to let down their guard. A moment
later, it pounces.

It is capable of reverting itself entirely
back to program data in order to enter
cyberspace. A Porygon is copy-
protected so it cannot be duplicated.

It was created by humans using the power
of science. It has been given artificial
intelligence that enables it to learn new
gestures and emotions on its own.

In order to create a more advanced
Pokémon, an additional program was
installed, but apparently it contained a
defect that made it move oddly.

One of the ancient and long-since-extinct
Pokémon that have been regenerated
from fossils by humans. If attacked,
it withdraws into its hard shell.

An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture
its prey. It is believed to have become
extinct because its shell grew too large,
making its movements slow and ponderous.

It is a Pokémon that has been regenerated
from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living
examples have been discovered. Kabuto
have not changed for 300 million years.

Kabutops once swam underwater to hunt 
for prey. It was apparently evolving from
being a water dweller to living on land as
evident from changes in its gills and legs.

Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age
of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA
extracted from amber. It is imagined to
have been the king of the skies.
The power of Mega Evolution has\ncompletely restored its genes. The rocks\non its body are harder than diamond.

When it finds something that looks like
it might be edible, it goes right ahead
and swallows it whole. That's why it gets
fatter day by day.

Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing
more than eating and sleeping. It is such
a docile Pokémon that there are children
who use its big belly as a place to play.

Gigantamax energy has affected
stray seeds and even pebbles that
got stuck to Snorlax, making them grow
to a huge size.

Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that
can control ice. The flapping of its wings
chills the air. As a result, it is said that
when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

It fires beams that immobilize opponents
as if they had been frozen solid.
Its feather-like blades of psychic energy
rip through thick iron sheets like paper.

Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that
has the ability to control electricity.
It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains
power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

When its feathers rub together, they
produce a crackling sound like the
zapping of electricity. Apparently, it runs
through the mountains at over 180 mph.

Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon
that can control fire. If injured, it is said
to dip its body in the molten magma of
a volcano to burn and heal itself.

This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura
will consume the spirit of any creature
it hits. Victims become burned-out
shadows of themselves.

A Dratini continually molts and sloughs
off its old skin. It does so because the
life energy within its body steadily builds
to reach uncontrollable levels.

A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of
energy inside its body. It is said to alter
the weather around it by loosing energy
from the crystals on its neck and tail.

It can circle the globe in just 16 hours.
It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads
lost and foundering ships in a storm
to the safety of land.

Mega Evolution has excessively
powered up this Pokémon's feelings
of kindness. It finishes off its
opponents with mercy in its heart.

A Pokémon that was created by genetic
manipulation. However, even though the
scientific power of humans made its body,
they failed to give it a warm heart.

Psychic power has augmented its muscles.
It has a grip strength of one ton and can
sprint a hundred meters in two seconds
flat!

Despite its diminished size, its mental
power has grown phenomenally. With a mere
thought, it can smash a skyscraper to
smithereens.

A Mew is said to possess the genes of all
Pokémon. It is capable of making itself
invisible at will, so it entirely avoids
notice even if it approaches people.

src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_2_fami.text:
It waves its leaf around to keep foes
at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also
wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly
atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up
leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree
shoot. The fragrance of this shoot
makes people peppy.

The fragrance of a Meganium's flower
soothes and calms emotions. In battle,
it gives off more of its becalming scent
to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

This Pokémon can fire a tremendously
powerful Solar Beam from its four
flowers. Another name for this is
Mega Sol Cannon.

It flares flames from its back to protect
itself. The fire burns vigorously if the
Pokémon is angry. When it is tired,
it sputters with incomplete combustion.

It intimidates foes with intense gusts of
flames and superheated air. Its quick
nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even
while scorching an enemy.

It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze
that it creates using its intense flames.
Typhlosion create blazing explosive
blasts that burn everything to cinders.

Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with
its flames and guide them to the afterlife.
It's believed its form was influenced by
the energy of Mt. Coronet in ancient times.

Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws
are very powerful. While it may think it is
just playfully nipping, its bite has enough
strength to cause serious injury.

Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will
absolutely not let go. Because the tips of
its fangs are forked back like fishhooks,
they become irremovably embedded.

It opens its huge mouth to intimidate
enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick
and powerful hind legs to charge the
foe with incredible speed.

With its arms and hoodlike fin, this
Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws
with a bite 10 times as powerful
as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.

They take turns standing guard when it
is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the
others if it senses danger. If one becomes
separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

A Furret has a very slim build. When under
attack, it can squirm through narrow
spaces and get away. In spite of its short
limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

It has an internal organ that senses
the earth's rotation. Using this special
organ, a Hoothoot begins hooting at
precisely the same time every day.

It unfailingly catches prey in darkness.
Noctowl owe their success to superior
vision that allows them to see in minimal
light, and to their supple and silent wings.

Ledyba communicate using a fluid that
they secrete from where the legs join the
body. They are said to convey feelings to
others by altering the fluid's scent.

It is said that in lands with clean air,
where the stars fill the sky, there live
many Ledian. For good reason, they use
the light of the stars as energy.

The web it spins can be considered its
second nervous system. It is said that a
Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny
vibrations it feels through the web.

Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws
that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and
vertical walls. It constricts its foe with
thin and strong silk webbing.

When it senses danger, it discharges
positive and negative electricity from its
two antennae. It lives in depths beyond
sunlight's reach.

The light-emitting orbs on its back are
very bright. They are formed from a part of
its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates
the inky darkness of deep seas.

As its energy, it uses the feelings of
compassion and pleasure exuded by
people and Pokémon. It stores up happy
feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good
fortune. When it spots someone who is pure
of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its
happiness with that person.

As everyone knows, it visits peaceful
regions, bringing them gifts of kindness
and sweet blessings. It will never appear
where there is strife.

It runs up short trees that grow on the
savanna to peck at new shoots.
A Natu's eyes look as if they are
always observing something.

It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing
the future. Some people in different lands
have long believed that Xatu are
emissaries from another world.

Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds
a static charge. The more energy is
charged, the more brightly the lightbulb
at the tip of its tail glows.

Its fleece quality changes to generate
strong static electricity with a small
amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its
hide are shielded against electricity.

It gives off so much light that it can be
seen even from space. People in the old
days used its light to send signals back
and forth with others far away.

Massive amounts of energy intensely
stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently
awakening its long-sleeping dragon's
blood.

Its tail, which is packed with nutrition,
is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny
days they gather at the edge of water and
splash about for fun.

Its body is covered with water-repellent
fur. Because of the fur, it can swim
through water at high speed without being
slowed by the water's resistance.

It lives in water virtually all day long.
Its body color and pattern act as
camouflage that makes it tough for
enemies to spot in water.

Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere.
In order to adjust the level of fluids
in its body, it exudes water from its eyes.
This makes it appear to be crying.

It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked
by enemies. But since its forelegs
remain green throughout the year, it is
easily identified as a fake in the winter.

This Pokémon drifts and floats with the
wind. If it senses the approach of strong
winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others
to prepare against being blown away.

It blossoms when the temperature rises
above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's
blooming changes with the temperature,
it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to
cross the sea and fly to foreign lands.
This Pokémon lands when it encounters
cold air while it is floating.

Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike
appendage. However, because it uses the
tail so much, Aipom's real hands have
become rather clumsy.

They live on large trees. Split into two,
the tails are so adept at handling and
doing things, Ambipom rarely uses
its hands now.

Sunkern try to minimize movement to
conserve the nutrients they have stored
in their bodies for evolution. They will
not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

Sunflora convert solar energy into
nutrition. They are highly active in the
warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as
soon as the sun sets.

It can see 360 degrees without moving
its eyes. It is a great flier capable of
making sudden stops and turning midair to
quickly chase down targeted prey.

This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable
of transporting an adult in flight. It is
adept at biting apart foes while flying
by at high speed.

Wooper usually live in water but come
out onto land seeking food occasionally.
On land, they coat their bodies with a
gooey, toxic film.

A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide
open in water and waiting for its prey to
blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it
does not get very hungry.

After losing a territorial struggle,
Wooper began living on land.
The Pokémon changed over time, developing
a poisonous film to protect its body.

When attacked, this Pokémon will
retaliate by sticking thick spines out
from its body. It's a risky move
that puts everything on the line.

Murkrow were feared as the alleged
bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong
interest in anything that sparkles. It will
even try to steal rings from women.

Becoming active at night, it is known
to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
It is said that it never forgives the
mistakes of its cronies.

A Misdreavus frightens people with a
creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses
its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes
as its nutrition.

Its cries sound like incantations.
Those hearing it are tormented by
headaches and hallucinations.
It appears where you least expect it.

A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits.
It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike
arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn
by the fragrance.

Usually docile, a Wobbuffet strikes back
ferociously if its black tail is attacked.
It makes its lair in caves where it waits
for nightfall.

A Girafarig is an herbivore--it eats
grass and tree shoots. While it is eating,
its tail makes chewing and swallowing
motions as if it were also eating.

Now that the brain waves from the
head and tail are synced up, the
psychic power of this Pokémon is 10
times stronger than Girafarig's.

A Pineco hangs from a tree branch and
waits for prey. While eating, if it is
disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it
falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

It keeps itself inside its steel shell.
The shell is opened when it is catching
prey, but it is so quick that the shell's
inside cannot be seen.

Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into
the ground backwards. This Pokémon is
known to make its nest in complex shapes
deep under the ground.

This Pokémon uses its hard tail to
make its nest by boring holes into
bedrock deep underground. The nest
can reach lengths of over six miles.

A recent study uncovered that the
number of segments a Dudunsparce's
body has is determined by the
Pokémon's genes.

It glides without making a single sound.
It grasps the face of its foe using its
hind and large front claws, then stabs
with its poison barb.

Gliscor observes prey while hanging
upside down from branches. Its flight is
soundless. When the chance presents
itself, it swoops!

By baring its fangs and making a scary
face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying
in terror. The Snubbull does seem a
little sad at making its foes flee.

It has a particularly well-developed lower
jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing
it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled,
it will not try to bite.

A Qwilfish uses the pressure of water
it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at
once from all over its body. It finds
swimming to be somewhat challenging.

A form of Qwilfish from the distant past.
Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon
because it sprays poison from its spines,
getting it everywhere.

Its lancelike spikes and savage
temperament have earned it the
nickname “Sea Fiend”.
It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its
body concealed inside its shell while
eating stored berries. The berries mix with
its body fluids to become a juice.

They gather in forests seeking the sweet
sap of trees. It is completely clad in a
steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn,
which it uses to fling foes.

A tremendous influx of energy builds it up,
but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross
is bothered by terrible soreness in its
muscles.

A Sneasel scales trees by punching its
hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out
unguarded nests and steals eggs for food
while the parents are away.

They travel in groups of four or five,
leaving signs for one another on trees
and rocks. They bring down their prey
with coordinated attacks.

Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for
traversing precipitous cliffs. From the
tips of these claws drips a venom that
infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught.

Because of its wicked poison and daunting
physical prowess, no other species could
hope to best it on frozen highlands. It
prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.

It licks its palms that are sweetened by
being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes
its own honey by blending fruits and pollen
collected by Beedrill.

In forests, it is said that there are many
streams and towering trees where an
Ursaring gathers food. It walks through
its forest collecting food every day.
Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly\nphysique and newfound capacity to\nmanipulate peat at will.

It crossed the sea and drifted
ashore in a new land. Surviving in this
place led it to take on a unique
appearance and gain special powers.

It is a species of Pokémon that lives in
volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin
hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that,
it sleeps near magma.

The shell on its back is made of hardened
magma. Tens of thousands of years spent
living in volcanic craters have turned
Magcargo's bodies into magma.

It roots for food by rubbing its snout
against the ground. Its favorite food is a
mushroom that grows under dried grass.
It occasionally roots out hot springs.

A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat
of long hair for enduring freezing cold.
It uses its tusks to dig up food that has
been buried under ice.

A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice
dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to
much amazement. This Pokémon has been
around for a long, long, long time.

Corsola live in warm southern seas.
If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful
coral stalks become discolored and crumble
away in tatters.

Sudden climate change wiped out this
ancient kind of Corsola. With its branches,
it absorbs others' life-force. It curses
those unaware that kick it by accident.

Its shell is overflowing with its
heightened otherworldly energy. The
ectoplasm serves as protection for this
Pokémon's core spirit.

A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles
to forcefully expel swallowed water, then
shoot down flying prey. When evolution
approaches, it travels down rivers.

It ensnares its foe with its suction-
cupped tentacles before delivering the
finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be
too strong, it spews ink to escape.

It carries food bundled up in its tail.
There was a famous explorer who
managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks
to a Delibird sharing its food.

When it swims close to the surface
of the ocean, people aboard ships are
able to observe the pattern on its back.
It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be
seen elegantly leaping over the waves.
It is not bothered by the Remoraid that
hitches rides.

A Pokémon that has a body and wings of
steel. People in the past used feathers
fallen from Skarmory to make swords and
knives.

Due to the effects of Mega Evolution,
its pincers have taken a more
diabolical form, ripping anything
they pierce to shreds.

Houndour communicate with each other
using a variety of cries to corner their
prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork
is simply unparalleled.

In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns
raked sharply back serves a leadership
role. They choose their leader by fighting
among themselves.

Its red claws and the tips of its tail are
melting from high internal temperatures
that are painful to Houndoom itself.

Phanpy's big ears serve as broad fans.
When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears
busily to cool down. Even the young are
very strong.

A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul
a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a
rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of
attack won't even leave a scratch.

Stantler's magnificent antlers were
once traded at high prices as works of art.
As a result, this Pokémon was hunted
close to extinction.

The black orbs shine with an uncanny light
when it is erecting invisible barriers.
The fur shed from its beard retains heat
and is useful for winter clothing.

A Smeargle marks its territory using a
fluid that leaks out from the tip of its
tail. About 5,000 different marks left by
this Pokémon have been found.

It gives over five gallons of milk daily.
Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and
grown-ups alike. People who can't drink
milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

Raikou embodies the speed of lightning.
Its roars send shock waves shuddering
through the air and ground as if
lightning bolts were crashing down.

Entei embodies the passion of magma.
It is thought to have been born in the
eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that
consumes all that it touches.

Suicune embodies the compassion of
a pure spring of water. It runs across
the land with gliding elegance. It has the
power to purify dirty water.

A Larvitar is born deep under the ground.
It must eat its way through the soil above
and reach the surface for it to see its
parents' faces.

A Pupitar creates a gas inside its body
that it ejects under compression to propel
itself like a jet. Its body can withstand
a collision with solid steel.

A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful,
it can bring down a whole mountain to make
its nest. It roams in mountains seeking
new opponents to fight.

Due to the colossal power poured into it,
this Pokémon's back split right open. Its
destructive instincts are the only thing
keeping it moving.

Lugia is so powerful even a light
fluttering of its wings can blow apart
houses. As a result, it chooses to live out
of sight deep under the sea.

Its feathers--which glow in seven colors
depending on the angle at which they are
struck by light--are thought to bring joy.
It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

This Pokémon came from the future by
crossing over time. It is thought that so
long as Celebi appears, a bright and
shining future awaits us.

src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_3_fami.text:
It makes its nest in a giant tree in the
forest. It ferociously guards against
anything nearing its territory. It is said
to be the protector of the forest's trees.

Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body.
They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes
of its enemies while it is in a thickly
overgrown forest.

In the jungle, its power is without equal.
This Pokémon carefully grows trees and
plants. It regulates its body temperature
by basking in sunlight.

Thanks to the power in its quick legs,
Mega Sceptile can be on its opponent in a
flash. It can cut off a portion of its tail
to fire it like a missile at an opponent.

If attacked, it strikes back by spitting
balls of fire it forms in its stomach.
A Torchic dislikes darkness because it
can't see its surroundings.

It lashes out with 10 kicks per second.
Its strong fighting instinct compels it
to keep up its offensive until the
opponent gives up.

It learns martial arts that use punches
and kicks. Every several years, its old
feathers burn off, and new, supple
feathers grow back in their place.

As it unleashes a flurry of savage kicks,
its legs can begin to burn from the
friction of the surrounding atmosphere.
They're always a source of pride to it.

On land, it can powerfully lift large
boulders by planting its four feet and
heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil
at the water's edge.

Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand
upright. Because it weakens if its skin
dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing
in mud.

If it senses the approach of a storm and
a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest
by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as
a jet ski.

When it Mega Evolves, the strength that it
needs to act in the water is increased.
It can use its tenacious power
both on land and in the water.

It savagely threatens foes with bared
fangs. It chases after fleeing targets
tenaciously. It turns tail and runs,
however, if the foe strikes back.

In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack.
They never defy their leader's orders.
They defeat foes with perfectly
coordinated teamwork.

Rubbing its nose against the ground, it
always wanders about back and forth in
search of something. It is distinguished
by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run
in a straight line. When it spots pond-
dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps
in and catches it with its sharp claws.

Its restlessness has it constantly moving
in zigzags. It will purposely run into other
Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to
be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.

This very aggressive Pokémon will
recklessly challenge opponents stronger
than itself. It uses its long tongue to
taunt them to then tackle forcefully.

Its voice is staggering in volume.
Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a
threatening posture and shout--this move
is known as Obstruct.

It sticks to tree branches and eats
leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth,
which becomes gooey when it touches
air, slows the movement of its foes.

It prepares for evolution using the
energy it stored while it was a Wurmple.
It keeps watch over the surroundings with
its two eyes.

Its colorfully patterned wings are its
most prominent feature. It flies through
flower-covered fields collecting pollen.
It attacks ferociously when angered.

To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides
motionlessly beneath large leaves and in
the gaps of branches. It also attaches
dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from
fields and mountains to the attraction of
streetlights at night. It looses highly
toxic powder from its wings.

This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean
water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon
across ponds by carrying them on the
broad leaf on its head.

In the evening, it takes great delight in
popping out of rivers and startling people.
It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on
rocks in the riverbed.

When it hears festive music, all the cells
in its body become stimulated, and it
begins moving in rhythm. It does not
quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

It hangs off branches and absorbs
nutrients. When it finishes eating, its
body becomes so heavy that it drops to
the ground with a thump.

A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled
at climbing trees. Its long and pointed
nose is its weak point. It loses power if
the nose is gripped.

It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds.
Feared from long ago as the guardian of
forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep
forest where people do not venture.

Although it is small, it is very courageous.
It will take on a larger Skarmory on an
equal footing. However, its will weakens if
it becomes hungry.

A Swellow dives upon prey from far above.
It never misses its targets. It takes to
the skies in search of lands with a warm
climate.

It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the
edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping
its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it
soars on updrafts.

It skims the tops of waves as it flies.
When it spots prey, it uses its large beak
to scoop up the victim with water.
It protects its eggs in its beak.

A Ralts has the power to sense the
emotions of people and Pokémon with the
horns on its head. It takes cover if it
senses any hostility.

A Kirlia has the psychic power to create 
a rip in the dimensions and see into the
future. It is said to dance with pleasure
on sunny mornings.

It apparently does not feel the pull of
gravity because it supports itself with
psychic power. It will give its life to
protect its Trainer.

By opening its heart, Mega Gardevoir
becomes able to use tremendous psychic
power. The red plate in its chest is said to
be a physical manifestation of its heart.

A master of courtesy and swordsmanship,
it fights using extending swords on its
elbows when trying to protect someone.
It can sense what its foe is thinking.

Mega Gallade has a knightly appearance.
It can use its psychic power to reshape
both arms into blades simultaneously and
fight using a dual-wielding style.

They gather on puddles after evening
downpours, gliding across the surface
of water as if sliding. It secretes honey
with a sweet aroma from its head.

It intimidates foes with the large eyelike
patterns on its antennae. Because it can't
fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself
from rain under large trees and eaves.

It loves to eat damp, composted soil in
forests. If you enter a forest after a
long rain, you can see many Shroomish
feasting on composted soil.

It scatters spores from holes in the cap
on its head. It loves warm and humid
climates. It feeds on trees and plants in
fields and forests.

It sleeps virtually all day and night long.
It doesn't change its nest its entire life,
but it sometimes travels great distances
by swimming in rivers.

It can't keep still because its blood boils
with energy. It runs through the fields
and mountains all day to calm itself. If it
doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

Hordes of Slaking gather around trees
when fruits come into season. They wait
around patiently for ripened fruits to fall
out of the trees.

It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty
tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it
probes its surroundings in the
pitch-black darkness of soil.

Because it darts about vigorously at high
speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing
its distinctive cries for too long induces
a headache.

A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even
though its wings remain completely still.
The inside of its body is hollow and
utterly dark.

Its cries equal a jet plane in volume.
It inhales through its ear canals. Because
of this system, it can cry continually
without having to catch its breath.

It positions the round speakers on its
head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves
at massive volume. It builds power by
stomping the ground.

It has sound-generating organs all over
its body. It communicates with others by
adjusting the tone and volume of the cries
it emits.

It loves to toughen up its body above all
else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave,
it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking
strenuous training.

It has the habit of challenging others
without hesitation to tests of strength.
It's been known to stand on train tracks
and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

Its body emits a powerful magnetism.
It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the
force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold
seasons.

It freely controls three units called
Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
With them, it can attack its foes from
three directions.

A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it
highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail
puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp
growl.

Rather than keeping a permanent lair,
it habitually seeks comfortable spots and
sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes
active at dusk.

It digs branching holes in caves using its
sharp claws in search of food--raw gems.
A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen
only rarely.
Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution,\nthe gemstone on its chest expands, rips\nthrough its skin, and falls out.

Its giant jaws are actually steel horns
that transformed. It fools foes into
complacency with its adorable gestures,
then chomps them with its huge jaws.

Its two sets of jaws thrash about
violently as if they each had a will of
their own. One gnash from them can turn a
boulder to dust.

A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor.
A new suit of armor is made when it evolves.
The old, discarded armor is salvaged as
metal for making iron products.

When two Lairon meet in the wild, they
fight for territory by bashing into each
other with their steel bodies. The sound
of their collision carries for miles.

Its iron horns grow longer a little at
a time. They are used to determine the
Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are
worn with pride as mementos from battles.

When Aggron Mega Evolves into
Mega Aggron, the destructive ability of
its fearsome horns can turn a steel-clad
tank into so much scrap metal.

It continually meditates for hours every
day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated
yoga training, it has tempered its
spiritual power so much it can fly.

Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it
gained the power to foretell its foe's
actions. It battles with elegant, dance-
like movement.

It uses its amped-up willpower to create
additional arms for itself. The more it
has trained its spirit, the more realistic
and dexterous these arms become.

It generates electricity using friction
from the atmosphere. In seasons with
especially arid air, its entire body blazes
with violent showers of sparks.

Because lightning falls in their vicinities,
Manectric were thought to have been born
from lightning. In battle, they create
thunderclouds.
Too much electricity has built up in its\nbody, irritating Manectric. Its explosive\nspeed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

It has the trait of cheering on its fellow
Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity
it releases from its paws, it creates
pom-poms for cheering.

At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was
announced that simultaneous exposure to
electricity from a Plusle and Minun will
promote circulation and boost vitality.

With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in
a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the
night sky. They move their nests if their
pond water becomes dirty.

A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active
upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm
to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200
different patterns have been confirmed.

Over the winter, it closes its bud and
endures the cold. Sensitive to changing
temperature, the bud is said to bloom
when it feels the sun's warm touch.

A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich
springwater blooms with lovely flowers.
The fragrance of its flowers has the
effect of making its foes careless.

Its sweet aroma attracts prey.
With the movements of a dancer,
it strikes with whips that are densely
lined with poison thorns.

This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even
digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can
swallow something that is as large as
itself.

Its powerful stomach acid is capable of
digesting almost anything. The one thing
in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is
its own stomach.

Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making
them sink. Although it is said to be a very
vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon
as it finds itself alone.

The vicious and sly gangster of the sea.
Its skin is specially textured to minimize
drag in water. Its speed tops out at over
75 miles per hour.

The yellow patterns it bears are old scars.
The energy from Mega Evolution runs
through them, causing it sharp pain and
suffering.

While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea,
it can survive on land, although not too
long. It loses vitality if its body becomes
dried out.

It breathes through nostrils that it
raises above the sea. By inhaling to its
maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close
to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump
on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can
transport a 220-pound load. It has served
humans at work since long ago.

A Pokémon that lives in the crater of
a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes
on its back erupt violently. Research is
under way on the cause of eruption.

The humps on its back have transformed
into one large and very active volcano. It
has a deep hatred of water or any moisture
and has an explosive personality.

It battles using energy it gets from
burning coal. When loosing smoke from its
nostrils, it lets off a sound that is
similar to a locomotive's horn.

A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power
at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when
it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms
that grow underground.

It stores power in the black pearls on its
forehead. When it uses psychic power, it
performs an odd dance step. Its style of
dancing became hugely popular overseas.

It is distinguished by a pattern of
spots that is always different. Its
unsteady, tottering walk has the
effect of fouling its foe's aim.

Its big jaws crunch through boulders.
Because its head is so big, it has a hard
time getting back upright if it tips over
onto its back.

It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its
wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings
are still in the process of growing, it can
only fly short distances.

The flapping of its wings sounds like
singing. To prevent detection by enemies,
it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of
desert sand.

Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no
rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick,
spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower
blooms.

After spending thousands of years in
harsh deserts, its blood transformed into
the same substances as sand. It is
nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

A Pokémon that has wings like cottony
clouds. After enduring winter, in which
little food is available, Swablu flocks
move closer to towns in the spring.

It hums in a beautiful soprano voice.
It flies among white clouds in the blue
sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs
from its mouth.

It sings with a voice that is even more
beautiful than before it Mega Evolved.
Its feathers became larger for protection
and glimmer with an iridescent sheen.

When it battles, it stands on its hind legs
and attacks with its sharply clawed
forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters
any Seviper.

Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals.
It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility
with its swordlike tail, which also oozes
a horrible poison.

It becomes very active on the night of
a full moon. This Pokémon was first
discovered 40 years ago at the site of
a meteor strike.

Solar energy is the source of this 
Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of
Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb
its light.

Its body is covered with a slimy film.
The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs
in muddy water from entering the
Barboach's body.

Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes.
In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the
bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it
continually feeds throughout the night.

Once it grips prey with its large pincers,
it will never let go, no matter what.
It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive
in any environment.

A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle.
A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in
hundreds of battles has giant pincers
marked with countless scars.

A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single
foot. It has been depicted in murals 
adorning the walls of a once-bustling city
in an ancient age.

A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair.
Its arms are separate from its body.
They are kept floating by the Pokémon's
manipulation of psychic power.

It disguises itself as seaweed by making
its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey
that come too close are swallowed whole.
It became extinct 100 million years ago.

It drags its heavy body along the
seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows
of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on
beaches when the tide goes out.

It was resurrected from a fossil using the
power of science. It swims by undulating
the eight wings at its sides. They were
feet that adapted to life in the sea.

Armaldo usually lives on land. However,
when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath
the ocean. It swims around using its two
large wings.

Feebas live in ponds that are heavily
infested with weeds. Because of its
hopelessly shabby appearance, it
seems as if few Trainers raise it.

It is said to live at the bottom of
large lakes. Considered to be the most
beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been
depicted in paintings and statues.

It alters its form depending on the
weather. Changes in the climate such as
the temperature and humidity appear to
affect its cellular structure.

Castform takes this form on bright days.
In an experiment where is was placed in
front of a heater, it didn't change to this
form. Its body is warm and toasty.

This is Castform's form while it's raining.
In an experiment where it was placed in a
shower, it didn't change to this form. Its
body is soft, slightly swollen with water.

This is Castform's form in a hailstorm.
In an experiment where it was placed
in a freezer, it didn't change to this form.
Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.

A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its
body colors to match its surroundings.
A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if
it is startled.

This Pokémon roams about deep in the
night seeking such negative emotions as
grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest
when the sun begins to rise.

An abandoned plush doll became this
Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage
dumps and wander about in search of the
children that threw them away.
Extraordinary energy amplifies its\ncursing power to such an extent that it\ncan't help but curse its own Trainer.

A glare from its single scarlet eye makes
even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear.
It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams
about under the cloak of darkness.

It is thought that its body is hollow with
only a spectral ball of fire burning inside.
However, no one has been able to
confirm this theory as fact.

This feared Pokémon is said to travel to
worlds unknown. Some even believe that
it takes lost spirits into its pliant body
and guides them home.

It flies by flapping its broad leaves.
The bunch of fruit that grows around its
neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring,
it scatters pollen from its neck.

There is an orb inside its mouth.
When it hops, the orb bounces all
over and makes a ringing sound.
It can cry for an awfully long time.

They fly about very actively when the hot
season arrives. They communicate among
themselves using seven different and
distinguishing cries.

It vibrates its entire body to attack in
all directions using sound waves. Any who
hear the vibrations get so confused, they
forget who they are.

It sharply senses even subtle changes in
the sky and the land to predict natural
disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that
has a life-span of 100 years.

As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it,
its fur bristles. What you see on its back
are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't
able to fly.

Using fur that it has made into sharp,
clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with
a single blow. This is an act of kindness
to keep them from suffering.

They tend to move about in groups of
around five Snorunt. In snowy regions,
it is said that when they are seen late at
night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

A Glalie has the power to instantaneously
freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice
crystals forms around its body.
The power of Mega Evolution was so strong\nthat it smashed Glalie's jaw. Its inability\nto eat very well leaves Glalie irritated.

When it finds people or Pokémon it likes,
it freezes them and takes them to its
chilly den, where they become its
decorations.

This Pokémon can use eerie cold
air imbued with ghost energy to
freeze even insubstantial things,
such as flames or the wind.

It is completely covered with plushy fur.
As a result, it never feels the cold even
when it is rolling about on ice floes or
diving in the sea.

Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its
powerful flippers, it shatters ice.
It dives into the sea to hunt prey five
times a day.

To protect its herd, the leader battles
anything that invades its territory, even
at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap
off in battle.

A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey
to prevent escape. The pearl it creates
upon evolution is said to be infused with
a mysterious energy.

To withstand the crushing pressure of
water deep under the sea, its spine is very
thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped
like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey
through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light
pink body color turns vivid when it
finishes feeding.

A Pokémon that was once believed to have
been extinct. The species has not changed
its form for 100 million years. It walks on
the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola
their nests. There is a custom from long
ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to
express one's feelings of love.

Although it is small, this Pokémon is very
powerful because its body is a bundle of
muscles. It launches head-butts with its
ironlike skull.

It hardly eats while it awaits evolution.
It becomes hardier by enduring hunger.
Its shell peels off the instant it begins
to evolve.

After many long years, its cellular
structure underwent a sudden mutation to
grow wings. When angered, it loses all
thought and rampages out of control.

Mega Evolution fuels its brutality, and it
may even turn on the Trainer who raised it.
It's been dubbed the blood-soaked.
crescent.

When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move
in perfect unison as if they were but one
Pokémon. They communicate with each other
using brain waves.

The claws tipping its arms pack the
destructive power to tear through thick
iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies
at over 60 miles per hour.

Metagross has four brains that are joined
by a complex neural network. As a result of
integration, this Pokémon is smarter than
a supercomputer.
When it knows it can't win, it digs the\nclaws on its legs into its opponent and\nstarts the countdown to a big explosion.

A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks
and boulders. If parts of its body chip off
in battle, Regirock repairs itself by
adding new rocks.

Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice.
After extensive studies, researchers
believe the ice was formed during an
ice age.

Its body is harder than any other kind of
metal. The body metal is composed of a
mysterious substance. Not only is it hard,
it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

They make a small herd of only several
members. They rarely make contact with
people or other Pokémon. They disappear
if they sense enemies.

Its body is smaller than Mega Latios's
body. It is more agile and can make very
sharp turns. When it Mega Evolves, its
defensive strength grows substantially.

Even in hiding, it can detect the locations
of others and sense their emotions since
it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows
it to understand human languages.

It's larger than Mega Latias, and can
achieve higher speeds in flight.
This Pokémon can use its speed in battle
to unleash a flurry of attacks.

Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the
creator of the sea. After long years of
feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at
the bottom of the sea.

When Kyogre roared, water poured forth
and the seas spread outward.
Dark clouds enshrouded the world,
and the deluge fell upon all…

Groudon has appeared in mythology as the
creator of the land. It sleeps in magma
underground and is said to make volcanoes
erupt on awakening.

When Groudon howled, the earth swelled and
the land grew wide. The sun blazed atop
and all the world around the creature
was enveloped in incandescent heat.

A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the
ozone layer. It is said it would descend
to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon
were to fight.

Particles stream from the filaments that
extend from its jaw. They can control the
density and humidity of the air, allowing
Rayquaza to manipulate the weather.

Jirachi is said to make wishes come true.
While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell
envelops the body to protect it from
enemies.

Deoxys emerged from a virus that came
from space. It is highly intelligent and
can shoot lasers from the crystalline
organ on its chest.
This Deoxys has transformed into its\naggressive guise. It can fool enemies\nby altering its appearance.
When it changes form, an aurora\nappears. It absorbs attacks by\naltering its cellular structure.

A Pokémon that mutated from an
extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser
beam. Its body is configured for superior 
agility and speed.

src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_4_fami.text:
The shell on its back is made of soil. 
On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell 
should feel moist. The leaf on its head
wilts if it is thirsty.

A Grotle that lives in the forest is said
to have its own secret springwater well. 
It carries fellow Pokémon there on 
its back.

Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's
back and spend their entire life there.
Ancient people imagined that beneath 
the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made
in its belly. Before going to sleep,
Chimchar extinguish the flame on their
tails to prevent fires.

It carefully controls the intensity of
the flame on its tail, so as to keep its
foes at an adequate distance.
Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

Its crown of fire is indicative of its
fiery nature. It uses a special kind of
martial arts involving all of its limbs to
take on any opponent.

A poor walker, it often falls down. However,
its strong pride makes it puff up its chest
without a care. It's difficult to bond with
since it won't listen to its Trainer.

Because every Prinplup considers itself
to be the most important, they can never
form a group. It searches for prey in
icy seas.

The three horns that extend from its
beak attest to its power. It avoids
unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate
anything that threatens its pride.

They flock around mountains and fields,
chasing after bug Pokémon. However,
they bicker if the group grows too big.
Their singing is noisy and annoying.

Recognizing their own weakness, they
maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles
break out between various flocks.
When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

When Staravia evolve into Staraptor,
they leave the flock to live alone. It has
a savage nature. It will courageously
challenge foes that are much larger.

Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier.
It can easily soar through the sky while
gripping a Steelix that weighs more than
880 lbs.

A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front
teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to
whittle down its front teeth.

It makes its nest by damming streams
with bark and mud. A river dammed by
Bibarel will never overflow its banks,
which is appreciated by people nearby.

It shakes its head back to front,
causing its antennae to hit each other
and sound like a xylophone.
These sounds are fall hallmarks.

It signals its emotions with its melodies.
There is a village that hosts a contest
based on the amazingly variable cries
of this Pokémon.

It rapidly contracts and relaxes its
muscles to generate electricity. Its
body shines if endangered. It flees
while the foe is momentarily blinded.

Strong electricity courses through the
tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch
has enough amperage to cause fainting
in foes.

It has eyes which can see through
anything. Luxray's ability to see
through objects comes in handy when
it's scouting for danger.

A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million
years ago, its skull is as hard as iron. 
It would snap obstructing trees with
headbutts.

The result of repeated headbutts
is a skull grown thick and hard.
However, its brain has shrunk in size
compared with Cranidos's.

This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles.
Few enemies would have been willing to
square off against its heavily armored
face, so it's thought.

Their rock-hard faces serve to protect
them from any frontral attacks.
When attacked, they form a wall.
They shielded their young in that way.

If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it
will immediately repair it with whatever is
near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak
is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

It weaves a cloak together with sand, mud,
and silk it spits out. This earthen cloak
is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon
hides away in caves and other such places.

When confronted by a lack of other
materials, Burmy will create its cloak
using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to
be more comfortable than one would think.

Its appearance changes depending
on where Burmy evolved. The materials
on hand become a part of its body.
The cloak is never shed.

Its earthen skin is reasonably hard, it has
no problem repelling a Starly's pecking.
It is said that a Wormadam that evolves
on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to
the scenery enough to be inconspicuous.
This seems to be the perfect way for it to
evade the detection of predators.

A Pokémon formed by three others.
It constantly gathers honey from flowers
to please Vespiquen. At night, they
cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

It houses its colony in cells in its body
and releases various pheromones to
make those grubs do its bidding.
There is only one in a colony.

A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek
pouches together in an effort to share
stored electricity. It stores them with
berries in tree holes.

It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its
face above water in order to watch for
prey movement. It swims by rotating its
two tails like a screw.

Its flotation sac developed as a result
of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double
as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues
of drowning people.

The small ball holds the nutrients needed
for evolution. Apparently, it is also very
sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and
Taillow try to peck it off.

It's motionless, save for the occasional
quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be
found gathered around it, drawn by the
scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

Cherrim takes this form on sunny days.
Its faint scent entices bug Pokémon to it.
It immediately closes its petals and
becomes immobile once the sun hides.

It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies.
While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
Apparently, there are more West Sea
Shellos now than there were in the past.

It's capable of spending a limited amount
of time on land until their skin dries out.
One theory suggests that living in cold
seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

It appears on shallow-water beaches to
eat sand for nourishment. Should one
Gastrodon encounter another of a
different color, a fierce battle will ensue.

Found more often on land than in the sea.
They normally live in rocky seashores, but
when cloudy or rainy, they can sometimes
be found on mountains, far from the sea.

Because of the way it floats aimlessly,
an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for
Wandering Spirits.” Children holding
them sometimes vanish.

Even while under careful observation,
large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk
will inexplicably disappear from view.
No one knows where they go.

You can tell how it feels by the way
it rolls its ears. When it's scared,
both ears are rolled up. When it senses
danger, it perks them up.

An extremely cautious Pokémon.
It is very conscious of its looks and
never fails to groom its ears.
It runs with sprightly jumps.

Mega Evolution awakens its combative
instincts. It has shed any fur that got in
the way of its attacks.
crescent.

It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is 
very popular among some. It claws its
Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and
purrs when affectionate.

It is a brazen brute that barges its way
into another Pokémon's nest and claims
it as its own. It binds its body with its
tails to make itself look bigger.

It protects itself by spraying a
nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear
to repel attackers. The stench lingers
for 24 hours.

It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly
fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid
smells worse the longer it is allowed
to fester.

Implements shaped like it were discovered
in ancient tombs. There are researchers
who believe this Pokémon reflected like a
mirror in the distant past.

In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as
a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir
when it was dug up at a construction site
after a 2000-year sleep.

It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to
trick them into thinking it's one of them.
This way they won't attack it. It can
also learn and speak human words.

A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds
resulted in it being bound to an
Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

It nests in horizontal holes warmed by
geothermal heat. Foes who stray too
close can expect to be pounced on
and bitten.

Shiny objects are its passion. It can be
found in its cave, scarcely moving,
its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed
or Carbink it has caught.

When it folds up its body and extends its
wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is
covered in fine scales that reduce drag,
enabling it to fly at high speeds.

Excess energy melted its arms and wings
into giant scythes, sending it mad with
rage. It swings its scythes wildly and
slices the ground to pieces.

Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved
form. It flies around foes at Mach speed
and cuts them to shreds with its sinister
wing claws.

It can discern the physical and emotional
states of people, Pokémon, and other
natural things from the shape of their
aura waves.

It understands human speech.
It is said that no foe can remain invisible
to Lucario, since it can detect Auras.
Even foes it could not otherwise see.

It readies itself to face its enemies by
focusing its mental energies. Its fighting
style can be summed up in a single word:
heartless.

By completely cloaking itself in its aura,
Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of
attacks, battling as if it were gracefully
dancing.

Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when
travelling through sand. Instead of
perspiration, it expels grains of sand
from its body.

It is surprisingly quick to anger.
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a
display of fearsome strength and raises
vast quantities of sand while attacking.

It grips prey with its tail claws and
injects poison. It tenaciously hangs
on until the poison takes.
It can survive a year without food.

Possessing a sturdy build, it takes
pride in its strength. It has the power
in its clawed arms to make scrap
out of a car.

Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating
its poison sacs, it fills the area with
an odd sound and hits flinching
opponents with a poison jab.

Swaying and dodging the attacks
of its foes, it weaves its flexible body
in close, then lunges out with its
poisonous claws.

Hanging from branches using its
tentacles, it looks like a plant.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling
saliva, then chomps down.

Its double tail fins propel its energetic
jumps. When it breaks the surface of the
sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on
the fly.

Lumineon swimming in the darkness
of the deep sea look like stars shining
in the night sky. It competes for food
with Lanturn.

During cold seasons, it migrates to the
mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly
curious about people, they gather around
footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

It lives a quiet life on mountains that
are perpetually covered in snow. It hides
itself by whipping up blizzards.
It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

The sprouts on Abomasnow's back grow into
great shafts of ice when it Mega Evolves.
Dislikes associating with others and
chooses to live quietly deep in mountains.

Its body is composed of plasma and loves
to surprise others. One boy's invention led
to the development of many machines that
can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.

If the convection microwave oven is
not working properly, then the Rotom
inhabiting it will become lethargic. It
makes mischief by turning up the heat.

It enjoys coming up with water-based
pranks. The model of washing machine that
Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued,
so they are now traded at high prices.

In this form, Rotom likes to play freezing
cold pranks. You may find it's turned the
bath you just filled to solid ice!
It battles by spewing cold air.

The first appliance developed that Rotom
coud inspirit was the electric fan. It uses
its power over wind in its pranks, happily
blowing any important documents it finds.

The lawn mower is an appliance that led to
the development of the Rotom Dex. It will
mow down grass and flowers, then swagger
around with pride at its accomplishments.

Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,”
according to some sources, this Pokémon
provided people with the intelligence
necessary to solve various problems.

Although it slumbers at the bottom of a
lake, its spirit is said to leave its body
and flitter on the water surface. It
taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.

This Pokémon is said to have endowed
humans with the determination needed to
do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit
and Azelf all came from the same egg.

A Pokémon spoken of in legend.
It completely controls the flow of time.
It uses its power to travel at will
through the past and future.

Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a
form bearing a striking resemblance to the
creator Pokémon. It wields such a colossal
strength that this might be its true form.

Palkia has the ability to distort space.
Its total control over the boundaries of
space enable it to transport itself to
faraway places and other dimensions.

It soars across the sky in a form that
resembles the creator of all things.
Perhaps this imitation of appearance is a
strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

Boiling blood, like magma, circulates
through its body. It dwells in volcanic
caves, using its cross-shaped feet
to crawl on ceilings and walls.

It's said that if it goes all out, it
can heat its body up to temperatures
over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit.
This heat keeps enemies at bay.

There is an enduring legend that
states this Pokémon shaped Regirock,
Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice,
and magma.

This Pokémon is said to live in a world
on the reverse side of ours, where common
knowledge is distorted and strange.
It was banished for its violence.

Giratina loses its legs upon changing into
this form. It's believed it hails from a
world where the heavens and the earth
are as one.

Those who sleep holding one of
Cresselia's feathers are assured of
joyful dreams. It is said to represent
the crescent moon.

When the water warms, they inflate the
flotation sac on their heads and drift
languidly on the sea in packs.
It always returns to where it was born.

Water makes up 80% of its body.
It starts its life with a wondrous power
that permits it to bond with any kind
of Pokémon.

It chases people and Pokémon from its
territory by causing them to experience
deep, nightmarish slumbers. However,
it means no harm.

Its dark power blocks out the sun,
plunging the surrounding area into
darkness. There is no escaping its
evil eye.

The flowers all over its body bloom if it is
lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It
dissolves toxins in the air to transform
ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

Upon taking in the scent of a particular
rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light
and its tiny body transforms, confering
the power of flight upon it.

src/data/pokemon/species_info/gen_5_fami.text:
This Pokémon brings victory.
It is said that Trainers with Victini
always win, regardless of the type
of encounter.

It is very intelligent and calm.
Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes
its movements swifter. When they are
not feeling well, their tails droop.

When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be
used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps
clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into
the shadows of thick foliage.

They raise their heads to intimidate foes,
but only give it their all when fighting
powerful opponents who are not fazed
by the glare from its noble eyes.

It loves to eat roasted berries, but
sometimes it gets too excited and burns
them to a crisp. It blows fire through
its nose.

The more it eats, the more fuel it has
to make the fire in its stomach stronger.
When it is angered, the intensity of the
flame increases.

It is adept at using many different moves.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its
fists on fire with its fiery chin.
It cares deeply about its friends.

Brandishing a blazing flame
shaped like a serpentine spear,
it rushes in to save its
imperiled allies.

The scalchop on its stomach isn't just
used for battle, it can be used to break
open hard berries as well. It is made
from the same element as its claws.

Strict training and disclipine leads it
to master its flowing double-scalchop
technique. Scalchop techniques differ
from one Dewott to another.

One swing of the seamitars attached
to its armor can fell an opponent.
A simple glare from one of them is
enough to intimidate most enemies.

Hard of heart and deft of blade,
this rare form of Samurott is a
product of the Pokémon's evolution in the
region of Hisui.

Extremely cautious, they take shifts to
maintain a constant watch of their nest.
Using food stored in cheek pouches,
they can keep watch for days.

Using luminescent matter, it makes its
eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see
in the dark.

It faces strong opponents with great
courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's
extremely popular with Trainers who live
in apartment buildings.

Its dense black fur grows continuously.
The high cost of keeping its hard fur
properly groomed makes this a
troublesome Pokémon to train.

Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant,
there could be no concern that it would
ever attack people. Some parents even
trust it to babysit.

Their deceptively cute act is the
perfect ruse. They steal from people for
fun, but their victims can't help but
forgive them.

Many Trainers are drawn to their
beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon
vanish and appear unexpectedly.
They run silently in the night.

This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest.
It's good at finding berries and gathers
them from all over. It's kind enough to
share them with friends.

Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by
swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
The leaf growing on its head is
very bitter.

The fire within the tuft on its head can
reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent,
it roasts berries before eating them.
It likes to help people.

It loves sweets because they become
energy for the fire burning inside its
body. It scatters embers from its head
and tail to sear its opponents.

The water stored inside the tuft of its
head is rich in nutrients. It waters
plants using its tail, plants that
receive its water grow large.

It can shoot highly-pressurised water
from its tail with enough power to
break through a solid concrete wall.
It prefers places with clean water.

This Pokémon appears before people
and Pokémon who are having nightmares
and eats those dreams. Munna always
float in the air.

The mist emanating from their foreheads
is packed with the dreams of people and
Pokémon. It changes into different colors
depending on the dream that was eaten.

This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for
a new order from its Trainer even though
it already has one. Flocks often gather
in parks and plazas.

No matter where in the world it goes,
it knows where its nest is, so it can
always return to its Trainer's location
regardless of the distance.

Males have plumage on their heads.
The females' flying abilities surpass
those of the males. They will only let
themselves feel close to their Trainers.

Its mane shines when it discharges
electricity. They use the frequency and
rhythm of these flashes to communicate
with one another.

When Zebstrika run at full speed, the
sound of thunder reverberates. It is
dangerous when it's angry as it shoots
lightning from its mane in all directions.

The hexagonal cavity is its ear.
It walks in the direction of sounds it
hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics
and topples over.

Its orange crystal is a mass of energy.
Just one crystal fragment would provide
enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

The blasts of energy it makes from
sunbeams have terrifying power.
However, it's not able to fire its blasts
at night or on rainy days.

Its habitat is dark forests and caves.
Suction from its nostrils enables it
to stick to cave walls during sleep.
It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

Anyone who comes into contact with
the ultrasonic waves emitted by a
courting male experiences a positive
mood shift.

It can dig through the ground at a
speed of 30 mph by spinning its body.
It could give a car running aboveground
a good race.

More than 300 feet below the surface,
they build mazelike nests. Their activity
can be destructive to subway tunnels,
but it can also help with construction.

If this Pokémon brings its arms and
head together to form a streamlined
shape and spins at high speeds,
it can destroy anything.

Its auditory sense is astounding.
Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell
how someone is feeling or when an egg
might hatch.

Mega Audino emits a soothing pulse from
its body that reduces hostility in others.
Anything that comes into contact with its
second feelers will fall into a deep sleep.

These Pokémon appear at building
sites and help out with construction.
They always carry squared logs.
As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

They strengthen their bodies by carrying
steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular
and strongly built that even a group of
wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

They use concrete pillars as walking
canes. Rather than rely solely on force,
they master moves that utilize the
centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound
waves imperceptible to humans. It uses
the rhythm of these sounds to talk and
warns others of danger.

It lives in the water and on land.
When they vibrate the bumps on their
heads, they can make waves in water
or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

It increases the power of its punches
by vibrating the bumps on its fists.
They can also shoot paralyzing liquid
from their head bumps.

When it tightens its belt, it becomes
stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave
their own belts. It changes belts as it
gets more powerful.

The sound of Sawk punching boulders
and trees can be heard all the way from
the mountains where they train.
Disturbing their training angers them.

It chews up leaves and sews them with
sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes,
it is a mascot for fashion designers.

Forests where Swadloon live have
superb foliage because the nutrients
they make from fallen leaves nourish
the plant life.

It keeps its eggs warm with heat from
fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to
weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by
using the silk secreted from its mouth.

Using the feelers on its head and tail,
it picks up vibrations in the air to
determine its prey's location and state.
It is brutally aggressive.

Storing energy for evolution, it sits.
But when attacked, it spins its body at
high speed like a wheel and then
crashes furiously into its opponent.

With quick movements, it chases down
its foes, attacking relentlessly with its
horns until it prevails. Then it finishes
them off with deadly poison.
Its deadly venom gives off a faint\nglow. The venom affects Scolipede's\nmind, honing its viciousness.

When it finds others of its kind, they all
stick together. When enough of them
have collected, the mass resembles a
cumulonimbus cloud.

It rides on the wind and slips into
people's homes. After it has turned a
room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles
to itself and takes off.

By pruning the leaves on its head with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown
into a fine plump shape. These bitter
leaves refresh those who eat them.

Even veteran Trainers face a challenge
in getting its beautiful flower to bloom.
It withers away if a trainer does not
take good care of it.

Its well-developed legs are the result of
a life spent on mountains covered in deep
snow. The scent it exudes from its flower
crown heartens those in proximity.

It used to be a common food source. The
